title: Schedule of Pause Terms, Auto Refill & Medication Sync
content:
Whether an Auto Refill & Medication Sync enrollment may be paused, the longest pause, the number of pauses in a program year and whether the enrollment resumes by itself when the pause ends are set per program in this schedule.

| Program | Enrollment may be paused | Longest pause, calendar days | Pauses allowed per program year | Resumes by itself when the pause ends |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day | Yes | 60 | 2 | Yes |
| Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day | Yes | 90 | 2 | Yes |
| Kestrel Med Sync Monthly | Yes | 60 | 2 | Yes |
| Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day | Yes | 90 | 2 | Yes |
| Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging | Yes | 30 | 1 | No |
| Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill | Yes | 90 | 2 | Yes |

## Notes to the schedule

1. Every program permits a pause.
2. The longest pause is stated in whole calendar days: 60 for the two 30-day programs (Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day and Kestrel Med Sync Monthly), 90 for the three 90-day programs (Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day, Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day and Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill), and 30 for Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging.
3. Two pauses per program year are allowed in every program except Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging, which allows 1.
4. Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging is the only program that does not resume by itself when the pause ends.
